The Idea

Two Responsibilities. One System.

Understand the buyer. Then make the solution relevant. Everything in this guide builds from those two habits.

Understand the Buyer

What are they trying to accomplish? What isn't working? Why does it matter? What would they like to change?

Make the Solution Relevant

Once you understand the situation, explain only what matters to that buyer — not the whole catalog.
